name: Cognatic Primogeniture
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] that follows the eldest line of the ruling family, preferring males over females. The descendants of a deceased [heir|e] inherit their parent's place in the line of succession before the [ruler|e]'s other children.

name: Absolute Cognatic Primogeniture
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] that follows the eldest line of the ruling family regardless of gender. The descendants of a deceased [heir|e] inherit their parent's place in the line of succession before the [ruler|e]'s other children.

name: Salic Law
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] in which the [ruler|e] is the oldest male child of the previous [ruler]. Female children can never inherit, nor transfer the right to the throne to their own sons.

name: Semi-Salic Law
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] in which the [ruler|e] is the oldest male child of the previous [ruler]. Female children can never inherit, but can transfer the right to the throne to their own sons.

name: Partition Inheritance
description:
It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] in which the [ruler|e] is the oldest male child of the previous [ruler] and all other male descendants receive rights to minor titles and territories. Female children can never inherit, nor transfer the right to the throne to their own sons.

When a new ruler rises to power the least controlled provinces of the country get further penalties to their [control|e] as they are divided between the brothers of the new ruler.

name: Fratricide
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] in which the new [ruler|e] ascends to the throne once he has demonstrated that his fortune is superior to the fortunes of his rivals, usually through the elimination of each one of them.

name: Unigeniture
description: A system of inheritance based around having one heir. The ascension of the eldest son of the royal family may mean instability between prospecting inheritors, and members of the ruling dynasty that are in the line of succession. This may result in instability, as other sons may only receive minor titles.

name: $mamluk$ Succession
description: $mamluk_succesion_regency_desc$

name: Youngest Son of Ruler
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a Kingdom in which the [ruler|e] is the youngest male child of the previous [ruler].

name: Tanistry Elective
description:
A traditional Gaelic form of government in which the ruling clan selects the most competent heir from amongst themselves. Being a patrilineal descendant of a historical ruler does increase one's chances of being selected, though it is considered improper to elect a child of the current ruler.

The process does tend towards the most qualified individual being selected, but because the rulership often meanders through multiple branches of the family tree in a somewhat arbitrary selection process, it frequently leads to feuds.

name: Elective Succession
description:
It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')], in which the new ruler is elected by the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. Although every noble would be eligible to be elected, the electors prefer a member of the current dynasty for the position of monarch.

$UNSTABLE_UNION_WARNING$

name: Dynastic Elective Succession
description:
It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')], in which the new ruler is elected by the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]. Only members of the ruling dynasty are eligible to be elected.

$UNSTABLE_UNION_WARNING$

name: Favored Son Succession
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] in which the old ruler would favor one of his sons over the others and designate him as heir paying no attention to their age.

name: Union of Crowns Succession
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] used by countries which have a special agreement with another [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')]. In case of the death of one of the rulers of either country without a legitimate male [heir|e], the other ruler will inherit the throne of the former.

name: Dynastic Cognatic Primogeniture
description: $cognatic_primogeniture_desc$ It is available after granting the [ShowGovernmentReformName('libertas_affectandi')]. In addition to the rules of cognatic primogeniture, the ruling dynasty has preferential treatment over the direct male line.

name: Matrilineal Salic Law
description: $semi_salic_law_desc$ Children of mothers of the ruling are preferred over children of mothers of different dynasties.

name: Judicial Election
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')], in which the new ruler is elected from the supreme court. The process is a bureaucratic chaos and can take several months or even years to be resolved.

name: Byzantine Succession
description: A complex system of succession that combines elements of primogeniture and elective monarchy, allowing for a more flexible approach to choosing a ruler while still maintaining a connection to the imperial lineage.

name: Oligarchic Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the [ruler|e] is selected from the ranks of the ruling minority by [election|e].

name: Republic 4 Year Terms
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the [ruler|e] is selected by [election|e] for an established tenure of 4 years.

name: Republic 2 Year Terms
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the [ruler|e] is selected by [election|e] for an established tenure of 2 years.

name: Lottery Election
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] in which the [ruler|e] is chosen by a single randomly selected ballot.

name: Veche Selection
description:
It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] in which the [ruler|e] is chosen among one or more candidates by a popular assembly or Veche.

$veche_selection_best_candidate_desc$

name: Doge Election
description:
It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] in which the [ruler|e] is elected from elites of the country and rules for lifetime.
However, the Doge can still be ousted should his popularity with the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] or with the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] drop.

name: Diarchic Election
description: It is a unique type of [heir_selection|e] of the Republic of [GetCountry('GEN').GetName] in which the [ruler|e] is chosen from the families of [ShowDynastyName('spinola_dynasty')] and [ShowDynastyName('doria_dynasty')].

name: Selection of the new Bank Executive
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a Banker Family in which the [ruler|e] is chosen among the members of the dynasty.

name: Pirate Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a Pirate [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] in which the [ruler|e] is chosen among one or more candidates by the crews.

name: Peasant Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] in which the [ruler|e] is a peasant selected by [election|e].

name: Military Dictatorship
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the most militarily prominent [character|e] rules for life.

name: Signoria Selection
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the [ruler|e] is elected for life among the members of a powerful family, and usually it is the child of the previous [ruler].

name: Elective Potestate
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')], in which the [ruler|e] is selected from a [country|e] that has presence in the [region|e] of its [capital|e].

name: Admiral Election
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of an [ShowGovernmentReformName('admiralty_regime_reform')], in which the new ruler is elected from the leading admirals. In case no admiral is available, a provisional council will lead the state until a fitting candidate has been found.

name: General Staff Election
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentReformName('military_regime_reform')], in which the new ruler is elected from the leading generals. In case no general is available, a provisional council will lead the state until a fitting candidate has been found.

name: $guru$ Election
description: Only a wise $guru$ can lead the country, and in absence of one we will have to wait until one appears.

name: Matrilineal Non-Exclusive
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a realm in which the new [ruler|e] is the most capable person in the dynasty of the previous [ruler].

name: Bishopric Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('theocracy')] in which the [ruler|e] is a bishop selected by [election|e] between possible domestic and international candidates.

name: Theocratic Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('theocracy')] in which the [ruler|e] is a theocrat selected by [election|e].

name: Grandmaster Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('theocracy')] with the [ShowGovernmentReformName('military_order_reform')] [government_reform|e], in which the [ruler|e] is selected from the ranks of the order by [election|e].

name: Abbot Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('theocracy')] in which the [ruler|e] is an abbot selected by [election|e].

name: Abbess Elective
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('theocracy')] in which the [ruler|e] is an abbess selected by [election|e].

name: Papal Conclave
description: When the Pope dies, the [cardinals|e] gather to debate who will be the new Pope. This can be quick, but sometimes it may take several years.

name: Tribal Oldest Male
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a Tribe in which the [ruler|e] is the oldest male child of the previous [ruler].

name: Tribal Matriarchal
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] of a Tribe in which the [ruler|e] is the oldest female child of the previous [ruler].

name: Ritual Selection
description: It is a type of [heir_selection|e] used in many cultures all around the world, in which the new ruler is chosen from the sons of the previous ruler through the celebration of a ritual competition where the winner gets the right to rule.
